steps.text: Every receipt you scan saves what you paid for each item, store by store. On Home, scroll down to Best Price Finder.

It counts the items you're tracking and the stores you've shopped, and shows what you could save each trip. Each item lists the cheaper store first, then the one that charged more, and how much you'd save.
Tap the card. Scorecard shows which store wins most often on the things you buy.
The more receipts you scan, the more items and stores it can compare for you.
